title: Go-live blockers found while writing the runbook
goal: Make the deploy scripts, infrastructure code and emailed links work the first time they are used for real.
why: Found by the go-live documentation pass (2026-10-15, docs/INFRA.md "Known gaps" and docs/GO-LIVE.md): several scripts and config files would fail or misbehave on first real use.
blockedOnOwner: decision: where the web pages that emails link to are hosted (APP_URL) and the domain name
steps: Terraform: add the four queues missing from terraform (travelcrm-ai-extraction-queue + -dlq, travelcrm-tenant-jobs + -dlq) to match backend/wrangler.base.toml; make the Oracle Cloud module optional (count/enabled flag, default off) so apply does not create the VM or require oci_* values until WordPress ships (Tier 3); remove the super_admin_password variable and its default; make environments/*.tfvars hold no example values that override a real terraform.tfvars (or stop passing them by default) and document it.

gen-wrangler.mjs --from-d1-remote: pass the generated/base config explicitly so it never reads the placeholder master id in backend/wrangler.toml; first deploy path (empty registry) documented and tested in the self-test.

push-secrets.sh and sync-config.sh: target the generated config with -c; fix ((PUSHED++)) under set -e; push only real secrets (plain settings go to [vars] via gen-wrangler); never overwrite an existing .dev.vars or sed wrangler.toml; root npm deploy/deploy:api/infra scripts made safe or removed.

Desktop auto-update: the update feed URL must be baked in at build time (TRAVELCRM_UPDATE_URL read by run-builder.mjs into the app config/electron-builder publish url) so customer PCs, which have no such env var, still check for updates; keep the env override for testing.

Weekly backup: add a dispatch + schedule workflow running backend/scripts/backup-tenants.mjs --remote --env production (secrets CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID); fix the missing -c in BACKUPS.md time-travel commands; note the dashboard vs generated database-name difference.
Domains: one placeholder domain used consistently (landing, console CORS/Caddy, terraform examples) from a single variable, pending the owner's choice.

Web host for emailed links (BLOCKED on owner decision): invite, password reset, shared quote /q/<token>, /download and /quick-start all point at APP_URL, but those pages exist only inside the desktop app. Implement the option the owner chooses (recommended: deploy the desktop Next app as a web build at app.<domain> on Cloudflare via OpenNext, like super-admin, which also gives agencies browser access; alternative: a small public site with only those pages).
tests: gen-wrangler self-test covers the empty-registry first deploy and the explicit config
terraform fmt -check and validate pass with the Oracle module disabled
a packaged desktop build without TRAVELCRM_UPDATE_URL in the environment still has the feed URL configured (Electron smoke)
acceptance: terraform plan with the Oracle module disabled needs no oci_* values
push-secrets.sh run in dry-run mode lists only secrets and the generated config path
every link in the welcome, invite, reset and quote emails opens a working page on the chosen host
gate: cd terraform && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
goLiveVerify: first real deploy from an empty registry
weekly backup job writes to R2
notes: Found by the documentation pass; see docs/INFRA.md Known gaps for the full list.
